messages:
anya: Anyone else seeing apiserver 502s and long controller-manager leader election times in ap-southeast1? GPU attach ops are queuing.
liam: Yup, started ~08:15 UTC. Not a full outage but attach_failures up and controller queue growth.
marta: Seeing lots of `AttachDevice` RPC errors and `connection reset by peer` in kubelet logs on gpu-nodes.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-20260320-813 apiserver 502 spike in ap-southeast1
ravi: Quick checks: apiserver pods restart count? `kubectl -n kube-system get pods -l component=kube-apiserver` -> 3/3 running, no restarts.
liam: But proxy forwarders show SYN_RECV -> ESTABLISHED increasing, netsniff shows many ephemeral port reuse.
anya: Suspect SNAT port exhaustion on NAT gateway — correlates with spike in egress connections from control plane to infra services (kvstore, metadata).
marta: Ran `ss -s` on proxy and saw high TCP timewaits: TIME-WAIT: 120k
liam: Also noticed etcd leader CPU spikes during the window, maybe compaction or snapshotting? logs:
```
etcdserver: starting a snapshot at 1234560
etcdserver: finished snapshot, took 2.2s
```
liam: no obvious WAL stall but leader switchover happened at 08:17:09
ravi: Controller-manager leader election timeouts show lease renew failures: `w=10s` renew err: context deadline exceeded
anya: Two hypotheses: (1) control-plane egress constrained -> health checks/timeouts. (2) kube-proxy/conntrack limitations on NAT instances causing packet drops.
kevin: On GPU attach path, CSI controller talks to device-plugin on node via hostNetwork and also convo with attach-proxy; if connections drop, attach queues back up and pods stuck.
marta: I pushed a quick mitigation: bumped SNAT pool size on NAT64-GW-2 and rotated conntrack tables: `conntrack -L | wc -l` then `conntrack -F` on one test NAT, seemed to reduce TIME_WAIT.
liam: After conntrack flush, apiserver 502s dropped and attach success rate improved, but not back to baseline.
anya: Next steps: increase NAT capacity, add ephemeral port range on control plane hosts, and instrument more metrics: conntrack count, SNAT usage, attach queue depth. Also add rate-limiting on noisy control-plane clients.
ravi: I'll open a follow-up RFC for long-term: autoscale NAT-proxy group + egress L7 balancer. Also schedule an etcd compaction review.
kevin: For short term: can we failover GPU pool to eu-west1 for critical workloads?
marta: I can trigger migration for 3 affected jobs, will coordinate.
liam: :thumbsup: keep us posted, saving logs into /var/log/sre/incidents/3333333000
ops-bot: Note: automated alert cleared at 08:42 UTC
anya: Thanks all — I'll create a postmortem draft (postmortems/3333333000-apiserver-proxy-snat-gpu-attach.md) and assign owners.
